name: Nador
registryBasis: ANCFCC's official external-services directory names a Nador Conservation Foncière and a Nador Cadastre office, with addresses and public telephone contacts. This is local custodian evidence, not evidence of an open parcel API.

routes.outcome: Official ANCFCC Arabic portal found; it lists electronic cadastral-plan and map services, but search-result material did not expose a public parcel feature endpoint.
Official directory confirms Nador Conservation Foncière and Nador Cadastre offices. No parcel response or service schema.
Official Arabic cadastral-products page describes cadastral plans, index maps, area calculation, and Lambert-linked cadastral mapping; general agency prose, not a city API.

Official cadastral-plan request form requires title/cadastre information and visible-code confirmation; it is a document-request workflow, not an anonymous parcel geometry service. No form was submitted.
Direct TLS-verified GET returned 49,381 bytes of HTML identifying a maintenance page. No viewer JavaScript/configuration or public map/API route was present.
